brokered_connections_holder_check.name: brokered_connections_holder_check
brokered_connections_holder_check.value: ("brokered_connections"."holder" = 'person' AND "brokered_connections"."user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("brokered_connections"."holder" = 'deployment' AND "brokered_connections"."user_id" IS NULL)

voice_sessions_summary_check.name: voice_sessions_summary_check
voice_sessions_summary_check.value: ("voice_sessions"."summary_status" = 'ready' AND "voice_sessions"."summary" IS NOT NULL) OR ("voice_sessions"."summary_status" = 'failed' AND "voice_sessions"."summary" IS NULL)

enterprise_membership_self_read.name: enterprise_membership_self_read
enterprise_membership_self_read.using: exists (select 1 from enterprise_principals p where p.id = enterprise_memberships.principal_id and p.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), ''))

enterprise_membership_data_read.name: enterprise_membership_data_read
enterprise_membership_data_read.using: enterprise_memberships.tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '') and enterprise_memberships.principal_id = nullif(current_setting('app.principal_id', true), '')

enterprise_membership_operator_update.name: enterprise_membership_operator_update
enterprise_membership_operator_update.using: enterprise_memberships.tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '') and enterprise_memberships.principal_id = nullif(current_setting('app.operator_principal_id', true), '')
enterprise_membership_operator_update.withCheck: enterprise_memberships.tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '') and enterprise_memberships.principal_id = nullif(current_setting('app.operator_principal_id', true), '')

enterprise_principal_data_read.name: enterprise_principal_data_read
enterprise_principal_data_read.using: enterprise_principals.id = nullif(current_setting('app.principal_id', true), '') and enterprise_principals.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')

enterprise_grant_operator_delete.name: enterprise_grant_operator_delete
enterprise_grant_operator_delete.using: enterprise_resource_grants.tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '') and enterprise_resource_grants.resource_id = nullif(current_setting('app.resource_id', true), '') and enterprise_resource_grants.principal_id = nullif(current_setting('app.operator_principal_id', true), '')

enterprise_resource_operator_update.name: enterprise_resource_operator_update
enterprise_resource_operator_update.using: enterprise_resources.tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '') and enterprise_resources.id = nullif(current_setting('app.resource_id', true), '')
enterprise_resource_operator_update.withCheck: enterprise_resources.tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '') and enterprise_resources.id = nullif(current_setting('app.resource_id', true), '')

enterprise_security_event_tenant_scope.name: enterprise_security_event_tenant_scope
enterprise_security_event_tenant_scope.using: enterprise_security_events.tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '') and enterprise_security_events.id = nullif(current_setting('app.operation_id', true), '')

enterprise_security_event_operator_inser.name: enterprise_security_event_operator_insert
enterprise_security_event_operator_inser.withCheck: enterprise_security_events.tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '') and enterprise_security_events.id = nullif(current_setting('app.operation_id', true), '')

enterprise_tenant_member_read.name: enterprise_tenant_member_read
enterprise_tenant_member_read.using: exists (select 1 from enterprise_memberships m join enterprise_principals p on p.id = m.principal_id where m.tenant_id = enterprise_tenants.id and p.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), ''))

enterprise_run_attempts_request_owner_ch.name: enterprise_run_attempts_request_owner_check
enterprise_run_attempts_request_owner_ch.value: ("enterprise_run_attempts"."request_owner_token" is null and "enterprise_run_attempts"."request_owner_expires_at" is null) or ("enterprise_run_attempts"."request_owner_token" is not null and "enterprise_run_attempts"."request_owner_expires_at" is not null)

enterprise_run_outbox_claim_check.name: enterprise_run_outbox_claim_check
enterprise_run_outbox_claim_check.value: ("enterprise_run_outbox"."claim_id" is null and "enterprise_run_outbox"."claim_owner_id" is null and "enterprise_run_outbox"."claim_expires_at" is null) or ("enterprise_run_outbox"."claim_id" is not null and "enterprise_run_outbox"."claim_owner_id" is not null and "enterprise_run_outbox"."claim_expires_at" is not null)

mastra_tenant_storage_state.name: mastra_tenant_storage_state
mastra_tenant_storage_state.value: ("mastra_tenant_storage_registry"."status" = 'provisioning' and "mastra_tenant_storage_registry"."claim_token" is not null and "mastra_tenant_storage_registry"."credential_ref" is null and "mastra_tenant_storage_registry"."runtime_role" is null and "mastra_tenant_storage_registry"."ready_at" is null) or ("mastra_tenant_storage_registry"."status" = 'ready' and "mastra_tenant_storage_registry"."claim_token" is null and "mastra_tenant_storage_registry"."credential_ref" is not null and "mastra_tenant_storage_registry"."runtime_role" is not null and "mastra_tenant_storage_registry"."ready_at" is not null)
